cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've pinned a ribbon to my bag like you. Will you wear mine or Nina's when we elect the chess-club chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This is Nina's spare. I'm carrying it back to her. You're both my friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, returning it. Keep us both as friends; which one do you want as chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's the vote. Wear whichever you like today; tell me whose you'll keep on when you vote.

reason: Make copied ribbon display a mistaken allegiance cue and use B proposed rotation to force the meaningful day.
